name: ub-test-reports v2.0.0
body:
Changelog:
<https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/blob/ub-test-reports-v2.0.0/packages/ub-test-reports/docs/changelog.rst>

## What's Changed
* ✨ ub-needs-exchange: a new library, the record of the needs.json format by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2219
* 📚 docs-theme: one useblocks furo look for sphinx-needs, sphinx-codelinks and sphinx-mounts by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2225
* 📚 ub-needs-exchange: 1.0.0 was released on 14 October, the day its pull request merged by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2226
* 📚 sphinx-test-reports: the docs move from sphinx-immaterial to furo and the shared useblocks look by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2227
* ♻️ sphinx-needs reads needs.json through ub-needs-exchange; `sphinx_needs.exchange` becomes a deprecated alias by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2229
* ✨ sphinx-needs: the join role — links and copy over the needs that match by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2228
* 📚 sphinx-test-reports: a TestReports wordmark pair and favicon, like the sibling sites' by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2237
* 🔧 CI: Windows cells install a pinned graphviz zip, cached, instead of Chocolatey by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2238
* 📚 sphinx-codelinks: the front-page hero spans the content width by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2239
* 📚 sphinx-mounts, sphinx-test-reports: a front-page hero like sphinx-needs' and sphinx-codelinks' by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2240
* 🏷️ Ship py.typed in the four Sphinx extensions, and switch on the type rules already clean by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2241
* 🏷️ ruff ANN on shipped code: every function annotated by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2242
* 🐛 ty: possibly-unresolved-reference, disjoint-cast and missing-type-argument on, and the bug the first found by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2243
* 🏷️ #1835 cheap fixes: a latent TypeError in FieldSchema, and three suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2248
* 👌 sphinx-needs: warn once when a derived link type stores too many links by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2258
* 🐛 `:need:`, `:need_outgoing:`, `:need_incoming:` and needtable show a need with no document unlinked (#2244) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2261
* 🏷️ sphinx-codelinks: check_schema skips a field with no schema; five suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2267
* 🐛 measure_time: a callable with no __name__ or no source is measured; ty checks the wrapper by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2268
* ♻️ The fields schema answers per need type: `FieldsSchema.for_type` and `add_type_overlay` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2266
* 🏷️ list2need: a TypedDict for the parsed item; `_get_title` takes lines; fifteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2270
* 🏷️ ty's unsound-* rules on ub-project and scripts/: the last three findings fixed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2272
* ♻️ The fields schema has two tiers: the union answers a field's shape, `for_type` its declaration; frozen once read; a per-type declaration is a narrowing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2275
* ✨ `needs_types` as a table keyed by directive, beside the list, validated at config-inited; one need type registers its directive once by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2276
* ✨ A need type declares its fields: `inherits`, `fields` and `links` on a `needs_types` entry, resolved into the schema; a needextend `-field` empties by the need's type by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2278
* ✨ A need type can be `closed`: its needs hold only the fields it declares; a needextend refused on a type warns once; the fields schema is frozen once built; a per-type `minItems` on a link type or `tags` needs no default by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2281
* ✨ A field declared on need types alone: one name, one shape; `derive` inside a need type's entry; `closed` withdrawn before release by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2284
* 👌 A need refuses a write to a derived field; the resolver writes through its own setter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2289
* 🧪 Fields per need type: a conformance corpus both tools run, with its runner shared with the derive corpus; a derived value is checked against the field's own declaration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2291
* ✨ A link type may be declared on the need types that have it alone: its labels, styles, `copy` and dead links set by its first root by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2292
* 🏷️ builder.py: the overrides take Sphinx's parameter names; ten suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2294
* 📚 Per-type configuration or schema rules: docs, how-to and tested examples by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2295
* 🐛 Sort the needs_global_options unknown-keys finding by @shivampwm2020 in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290
* 📚 The documentation's own configuration uses per-type declarations by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2302
* 🏷️ Directive nodes declare their attributes' TypedDict; needextract's own four; fourteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2304
* 🐛 One rule for a link type's back links meeting a field or link type of their name by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2305
* 🧪 needs.json without its defaults, under per-type defaults: left out where a value equals its schema default as the same JSON type, restored from the file's own schema by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2306
* 📚 Need types: a walkthrough with diagrams, a reference without repeats, and the path of a need's values by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2309
* 🏷️ filter_common and needbar: nineteen suppressions gone, and two filter fast-path bugs fixed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2308
* 🐛 Need types and layouts added from code stay out of needs_types and needs_layouts, so an incremental build no longer reports a changed configuration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2307
* 🐛 Unset values in needtable sorts and layout placeholders, a changed needs_types on incremental builds, a needextend without needs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2311
* 🏷️ NeedsList declares the needs.json it holds; eleven suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2313
* 🏷️ needextend: an append's computed value is read as what it is; eight suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2315
* 🐛 needs_fields' default wins over needs_global_options', and needs.json writes a narrowed core field as declared by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2318
* ‼️ Register the built-in GitHub services only when needs_services names them by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2321
* 🐛 A needs_links default wins over needs_global_options by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2328
* 🧪 Pin `required` on `content` in the schema fixtures by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2330
* ‼️ ub-needs-exchange 1.1.0: a format_version naming a later format refuses the file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2334
* ✨ target_types on a link type: which need types its links may point to by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2319
* 🐛 A network schema finding's header names the need the rule selected by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2340
* 🐛 target_types: refused on links beside a copying link type; how it combines with minItems by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2342
* ✨ A derived union of link types; `copy = true` deprecated into it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2343
* 📚 Derived fields get a page of their own by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2344
* 📚 Say X-as-Code on the docs landing page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2348
* Bump uv from 0.12.21 to 0.13.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2349
* Bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2351
* Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2352
* ⚡️ Filter strings in the portable filter language run without eval, five to six times faster, for the whole language; needs_debug_filters says which tier answered each filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2350
* 👌 Derive follow-ups: bare default-type entries, unions over late members, allow_dead_links beside an unreadable union by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2353
* 👌 A filter is read for its truth on every tier, and a filter that is a constant is refused by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2364
* 📚 Sphinx-Needs across the V-model: a page that maps define, implement, verify, iterate and prove by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2365
* ✨ Functions of your own can declare what they read, and every remaining late read is reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2366
* 📚 Changelog: what upgrading means for the new late-read warnings by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2367
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.1.0, with sphinx-codelinks 2.0.1 and sphinx-test-reports 3.0.1 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2368
* 🧪 The extension-field test skips without sphinx-test-reports, which the release compat cell never installs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2369
* 🧪 Smoke-test sphinx-needs against its workspace siblings from the tree; the published check becomes informational by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2385
* 🐛 ub-test-reports: the documented warning filter works on pytest 9.2 again by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2386
* 👌 A variant data-file override swaps the file, never the table (ub-project contract §6.8) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2383
* 📚 Read the Docs: install ub-project from the checkout, ahead of the packages that need it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2387
* ✨ Derive: `empty` on `any`/`all`, `where` beside a copy, and the derive corpus follow-ups by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2384
* 👌 Field and link type entries: unknown keys and schema keywords reported, near names caught, the link default written, a failed build keeps its error by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2388
* 🐛 A need takes the name of its nearest enclosing domain object as its signature, however the domain writes it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2397
* 🧹 CI: keep release dist and Docker build records for 7 days, not 90 by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2396
* ✨ Per-type declarations: a severity, a count of incoming links, and an id pattern by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2395
* ✨ Extension need types and fields per type: a `needs_types` entry narrows an extension's type, `add_field(types=…)`, and sphinx-test-reports' fields on their own types by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2400
* ✨ Every need records where its text came from, as hops on its source (provisional; nothing shown changes) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2399
* ✨ Filters follow `inherits`: `c.is_a('req')` selects a type and the types inheriting from it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2401
* 🐛 Schema rules take `contains` without `items`, and a `needs_fields` entry naming a computed core field is reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2405
* ✨ create_need: a need's fields and links as two mappings, the need returned — and a field named like an add_need parameter no longer ends the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2406
* 🐛 An incremental build re-writes every page showing a need that changed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2414
* 🐛 A need with :hide: is located as a visible need in the same place is by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2415
* ✨ NeedItemSource: one class for where a need comes from, and add_need is deprecated in favour of create_need by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2419
* ✨ Summary link types, and `copy` / `collect` on a link type: a chain's far ends as links by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2418
* 🔧 sphinx-codelinks and sphinx-test-reports: no private Sphinx-Needs id helper, and no pre-9.0.0 guard by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2423
* 📚 Derived fields: lead every section with what it is for by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2425
* ✨ sphinx-test-reports: a test need is at the line it is written on, and records where it comes from by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2426
* 🐛 needs_external_needs: an absolute target_url is used as it is by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2429
* 🐛 Google Test's value_param / type_param reach case_parameter, in the build and the converter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2430
* ‼️ Test-case lines from pytest reports are the test's own line by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2431
* 🔧 Benchmarks: time sphinx-needs, not the runner, and judge against same-CPU history by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2432
* 👌 A link type declared on need types alone can be a summary by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2433
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: name the code entity a marker documents, and attach only to an adjacent one by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2435
* 🧪 A test fails when the shape of the data stored in the environment changes without an ENV_DATA_VERSION bump by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2436
* 🐛 A need in a sliced include records the line it is written on in the file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2437
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: every need records where it comes from: its source file, lines, entity and language by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2440
* 👌 Autodoc's docstring hop records python and the in-file qualified name, in sphinx-codelinks' Python kinds by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2443
* 🔧 Sphinx's configuration holds the declared options alone: the variant proxy and the c.is_a type sets move to sphinx-needs' own store by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2444
* ✨ A misspelt type in c.is_a is reported, with a did-you-mean by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2445
* 👌 Source hops record the include chain, an API need's page, an external need's sections, a test file's language and a code entity's qualified name by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2448
* 🔧 Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.2.0 to 10.3.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2453
* 🔧 Bump bazel-contrib/setup-bazel from 0.19.0 to 0.19.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2452
* 🔧 Update pre-commit hook versions by @useblocks-automation[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2454
* ✨ Filter by where a need comes from: c.source.path, c.source.kind, c.source.paths, c.source.line, c.source.symbol by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2451
* 🐛 A test case with no test file in its report has no `c.source.path` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2456
* 🧪 Three c.source corpus entries ubCode now answers lose their divergent marker by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2458
* ⬆️ Update the uv lock (monthly), with the ty 0.0.95 diagnostics answered by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2459
* ♻️ One walk locates each need: sections, signature and parent_needs from the semantic location by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2460
* 🐛 Match directive option names to declared field, link and extra-option names ignoring case by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2462
* 🐛 A need a needimport or needservice creates records the line its directive is written on (changed output) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2461
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a multi-line need's duplicate check and [docs] link name the id it is given by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2464
* ♻️ A stable API that can grow: `create_need` takes a `NeedItemSource`, `resolve_need_option` is new, and "what is public" is written down by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2468
* ✨ sphinx-ub-directives: directive presets and template directives from ubproject.toml by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2382
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.2.0, with ub-project 1.2.0, ub-test-reports 2.0.0, sphinx-codelinks 2.1.0, sphinx-test-reports 4.0.0, sphinx-mounts 0.3.1 and sphinx-ub-directives 0.1.0 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2472

## New Contributors
* @shivampwm2020 made their first contribution in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/ub-test-reports-v1.1.0...ub-test-reports-v2.0.0

name: ub-project v1.2.0
body:
Changelog:
<https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/blob/ub-project-v1.2.0/packages/ub-project/docs/changelog.rst>

## What's Changed
* ✨ sphinx-needs: read variant data from `[variants]` through ub-project, keeping `[needs] variant_data*` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1996
* ♻️ sphinx-needs: one copy of the variant-data functions, ub-project's by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1998
* ✨ sphinx-mounts: read variant data from `[variants]` through ub-project, keeping `[needs] variant_data*` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2000
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: read ubproject.toml through ub-project, and let -D override the TOML by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2005
* ‼️ Split sphinx-test-reports: the Sphinx-free core becomes ub-test-reports 1.0.0 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2009
* 🚀 Release ub-test-reports 1.0.0 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2019
* 🔧 Update pre-commit hook versions by @useblocks-automation[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2010
* ⬆️ Update the uv lock (monthly) by @useblocks-automation[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2012
* 🐛 Normalize conf.py codelinks projects by @kocaemre in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2008
* 🧪 CI: upload coverage on pushes to master too by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2023
* ✨ sphinx-needs: `choose` / `when` / `otherwise` directives, one of several branches by variant data by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2020
* 🐛 fix: read JSON test reports as UTF-8 by @kocaemre in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2024
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: harden the `if` / `when` evaluator and `if` locations by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2029
* 🔧 Import sphinx-ai-index into the workspace, and build its index in every sphinx-* docs site by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2031
* 🔧 .gitignore: `ub-test-reports.xml`, the coverage file its CI step writes at the root by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2036
* 🧪 sphinx-ai-index: every text read and write in the tests names its encoding by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2037
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: register the URL string links at config-inited, not at read time by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2047
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: attach @need-ids references to the needs they name, during the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2049
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: incremental builds see new source files, and a project without a src-trace directive gets its @need-ids references by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2065
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: need-id order for `calc_sum` and `copy(filter=)` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2078
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a TOML `functions` key warns instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2079
* ✨ sphinx-needs: needextend `:extend_priority:`; warn where a filter depends on earlier extends by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2083
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a source file behind a symbolic link is analysed once by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2085
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: overlapping src-trace scopes no longer abort the build — the first directive defines a one-line need, the others skip it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2086
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: diagnose a git_root that does not contain src_dir, a file outside src_dir, and a :file: scope naming no file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2090
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: malformed one-line markers are reported in the build, at the source line by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2092
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a one-line need without an id field no longer crashes the directive when local URLs are on by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2093
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: the source copies and pages are build state — present in every HTML output, under -j N too by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2094
* 🔧 sphinx-codelinks: an .ignore at the root of every builder's output keeps it out of discovery by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2096
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needextend :+field: on an unset nullable field sets the field instead of crashing the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2102

name: sphinx-mounts v0.3.1
body:
Changelog:
<https://sphinx-mounts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html#release-0-3-1>

## What's Changed
* ✨ ub-needs-exchange: a new library, the record of the needs.json format by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2219
* 📚 docs-theme: one useblocks furo look for sphinx-needs, sphinx-codelinks and sphinx-mounts by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2225
* 📚 ub-needs-exchange: 1.0.0 was released on 14 October, the day its pull request merged by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2226
* 📚 sphinx-test-reports: the docs move from sphinx-immaterial to furo and the shared useblocks look by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2227
* ♻️ sphinx-needs reads needs.json through ub-needs-exchange; `sphinx_needs.exchange` becomes a deprecated alias by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2229
* ✨ sphinx-needs: the join role — links and copy over the needs that match by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2228
* 📚 sphinx-test-reports: a TestReports wordmark pair and favicon, like the sibling sites' by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2237
* 🔧 CI: Windows cells install a pinned graphviz zip, cached, instead of Chocolatey by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2238
* 📚 sphinx-codelinks: the front-page hero spans the content width by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2239
* 📚 sphinx-mounts, sphinx-test-reports: a front-page hero like sphinx-needs' and sphinx-codelinks' by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2240
* 🏷️ Ship py.typed in the four Sphinx extensions, and switch on the type rules already clean by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2241
* 🏷️ ruff ANN on shipped code: every function annotated by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2242
* 🐛 ty: possibly-unresolved-reference, disjoint-cast and missing-type-argument on, and the bug the first found by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2243
* 🏷️ #1835 cheap fixes: a latent TypeError in FieldSchema, and three suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2248
* 👌 sphinx-needs: warn once when a derived link type stores too many links by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2258
* 🐛 `:need:`, `:need_outgoing:`, `:need_incoming:` and needtable show a need with no document unlinked (#2244) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2261
* 🏷️ sphinx-codelinks: check_schema skips a field with no schema; five suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2267
* 🐛 measure_time: a callable with no __name__ or no source is measured; ty checks the wrapper by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2268
* ♻️ The fields schema answers per need type: `FieldsSchema.for_type` and `add_type_overlay` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2266
* 🏷️ list2need: a TypedDict for the parsed item; `_get_title` takes lines; fifteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2270

* ✨ `needs_types` as a table keyed by directive, beside the list, validated at config-inited; one need type registers its directive once by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2276
* ✨ A need type declares its fields: `inherits`, `fields` and `links` on a `needs_types` entry, resolved into the schema; a needextend `-field` empties by the need's type by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2278

* ✨ A field declared on need types alone: one name, one shape; `derive` inside a need type's entry; `closed` withdrawn before release by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2284
* 👌 A need refuses a write to a derived field; the resolver writes through its own setter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2289
* 🧪 Fields per need type: a conformance corpus both tools run, with its runner shared with the derive corpus; a derived value is checked against the field's own declaration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2291
* ✨ A link type may be declared on the need types that have it alone: its labels, styles, `copy` and dead links set by its first root by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2292
* 🏷️ builder.py: the overrides take Sphinx's parameter names; ten suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2294
* 📚 Per-type configuration or schema rules: docs, how-to and tested examples by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2295
* 🐛 Sort the needs_global_options unknown-keys finding by @shivampwm2020 in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290
* 📚 The documentation's own configuration uses per-type declarations by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2302
* 🏷️ Directive nodes declare their attributes' TypedDict; needextract's own four; fourteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2304
* 🐛 One rule for a link type's back links meeting a field or link type of their name by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2305
* 🧪 needs.json without its defaults, under per-type defaults: left out where a value equals its schema default as the same JSON type, restored from the file's own schema by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2306
* 📚 Need types: a walkthrough with diagrams, a reference without repeats, and the path of a need's values by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2309
* 🏷️ filter_common and needbar: nineteen suppressions gone, and two filter fast-path bugs fixed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2308
* 🐛 Need types and layouts added from code stay out of needs_types and needs_layouts, so an incremental build no longer reports a changed configuration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2307
* 🐛 Unset values in needtable sorts and layout placeholders, a changed needs_types on incremental builds, a needextend without needs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2311
* 🏷️ NeedsList declares the needs.json it holds; eleven suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2313
* 🏷️ needextend: an append's computed value is read as what it is; eight suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2315
* 🐛 needs_fields' default wins over needs_global_options', and needs.json writes a narrowed core field as declared by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2318
* ‼️ Register the built-in GitHub services only when needs_services names them by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2321
* 🐛 A needs_links default wins over needs_global_options by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2328
* 🧪 Pin `required` on `content` in the schema fixtures by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2330
* ‼️ ub-needs-exchange 1.1.0: a format_version naming a later format refuses the file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2334
* ✨ target_types on a link type: which need types its links may point to by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2319
* 🐛 A network schema finding's header names the need the rule selected by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2340
* 🐛 target_types: refused on links beside a copying link type; how it combines with minItems by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2342
* ✨ A derived union of link types; `copy = true` deprecated into it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2343
* 📚 Derived fields get a page of their own by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2344
* 📚 Say X-as-Code on the docs landing page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2348
* Bump uv from 0.12.21 to 0.13.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2349
* Bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2351
* Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2352
* ⚡️ Filter strings in the portable filter language run without eval, five to six times faster, for the whole language; needs_debug_filters says which tier answered each filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2350
* 👌 Derive follow-ups: bare default-type entries, unions over late members, allow_dead_links beside an unreadable union by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2353
* 👌 A filter is read for its truth on every tier, and a filter that is a constant is refused by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2364
* 📚 Sphinx-Needs across the V-model: a page that maps define, implement, verify, iterate and prove by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2365
* ✨ Functions of your own can declare what they read, and every remaining late read is reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2366
* 📚 Changelog: what upgrading means for the new late-read warnings by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2367
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.1.0, with sphinx-codelinks 2.0.1 and sphinx-test-reports 3.0.1 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2368
* 🧪 The extension-field test skips without sphinx-test-reports, which the release compat cell never installs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2369
* 🧪 Smoke-test sphinx-needs against its workspace siblings from the tree; the published check becomes informational by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2385
* 🐛 ub-test-reports: the documented warning filter works on pytest 9.2 again by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2386
* 👌 A variant data-file override swaps the file, never the table (ub-project contract §6.8) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2383
* 📚 Read the Docs: install ub-project from the checkout, ahead of the packages that need it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2387
* ✨ Derive: `empty` on `any`/`all`, `where` beside a copy, and the derive corpus follow-ups by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2384
* 👌 Field and link type entries: unknown keys and schema keywords reported, near names caught, the link default written, a failed build keeps its error by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2388
* 🐛 A need takes the name of its nearest enclosing domain object as its signature, however the domain writes it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2397
* 🧹 CI: keep release dist and Docker build records for 7 days, not 90 by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2396
* ✨ Per-type declarations: a severity, a count of incoming links, and an id pattern by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2395
* ✨ Extension need types and fields per type: a `needs_types` entry narrows an extension's type, `add_field(types=…)`, and sphinx-test-reports' fields on their own types by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2400
* ✨ Every need records where its text came from, as hops on its source (provisional; nothing shown changes) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2399
* ✨ Filters follow `inherits`: `c.is_a('req')` selects a type and the types inheriting from it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2401
* 🐛 Schema rules take `contains` without `items`, and a `needs_fields` entry naming a computed core field is reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2405
* ✨ create_need: a need's fields and links as two mappings, the need returned — and a field named like an add_need parameter no longer ends the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2406
* 🐛 An incremental build re-writes every page showing a need that changed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2414
* 🐛 A need with :hide: is located as a visible need in the same place is by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2415
* ✨ NeedItemSource: one class for where a need comes from, and add_need is deprecated in favour of create_need by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2419
* ✨ Summary link types, and `copy` / `collect` on a link type: a chain's far ends as links by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2418
* 🔧 sphinx-codelinks and sphinx-test-reports: no private Sphinx-Needs id helper, and no pre-9.0.0 guard by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2423
* 📚 Derived fields: lead every section with what it is for by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2425
* ✨ sphinx-test-reports: a test need is at the line it is written on, and records where it comes from by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2426
* 🐛 needs_external_needs: an absolute target_url is used as it is by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2429
* 🐛 Google Test's value_param / type_param reach case_parameter, in the build and the converter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2430
* ‼️ Test-case lines from pytest reports are the test's own line by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2431
* 🔧 Benchmarks: time sphinx-needs, not the runner, and judge against same-CPU history by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2432
* 👌 A link type declared on need types alone can be a summary by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2433
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: name the code entity a marker documents, and attach only to an adjacent one by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2435
* 🧪 A test fails when the shape of the data stored in the environment changes without an ENV_DATA_VERSION bump by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2436
* 🐛 A need in a sliced include records the line it is written on in the file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2437
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: every need records where it comes from: its source file, lines, entity and language by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2440
* 👌 Autodoc's docstring hop records python and the in-file qualified name, in sphinx-codelinks' Python kinds by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2443
* 🔧 Sphinx's configuration holds the declared options alone: the variant proxy and the c.is_a type sets move to sphinx-needs' own store by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2444
* ✨ A misspelt type in c.is_a is reported, with a did-you-mean by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2445
* 👌 Source hops record the include chain, an API need's page, an external need's sections, a test file's language and a code entity's qualified name by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2448
* 🔧 Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.2.0 to 10.3.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2453
* 🔧 Bump bazel-contrib/setup-bazel from 0.19.0 to 0.19.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2452
* 🔧 Update pre-commit hook versions by @useblocks-automation[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2454
* ✨ Filter by where a need comes from: c.source.path, c.source.kind, c.source.paths, c.source.line, c.source.symbol by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2451
* 🐛 A test case with no test file in its report has no `c.source.path` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2456
* 🧪 Three c.source corpus entries ubCode now answers lose their divergent marker by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2458
* ⬆️ Update the uv lock (monthly), with the ty 0.0.95 diagnostics answered by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2459
* ♻️ One walk locates each need: sections, signature and parent_needs from the semantic location by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2460
* 🐛 Match directive option names to declared field, link and extra-option names ignoring case by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2462
* 🐛 A need a needimport or needservice creates records the line its directive is written on (changed output) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2461
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a multi-line need's duplicate check and [docs] link name the id it is given by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2464
* ♻️ A stable API that can grow: `create_need` takes a `NeedItemSource`, `resolve_need_option` is new, and "what is public" is written down by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2468
* ✨ sphinx-ub-directives: directive presets and template directives from ubproject.toml by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2382
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.2.0, with ub-project 1.2.0, ub-test-reports 2.0.0, sphinx-codelinks 2.1.0, sphinx-test-reports 4.0.0, sphinx-mounts 0.3.1 and sphinx-ub-directives 0.1.0 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2472

## New Contributors
* @shivampwm2020 made their first contribution in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/sphinx-mounts-v0.3.0...sphinx-mounts-v0.3.1

* 👌 A need refuses a write to a derived field; the resolver writes through its own setter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2289
* 🧪 Fields per need type: a conformance corpus both tools run, with its runner shared with the derive corpus; a derived value is checked against the field's own declaration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2291
* ✨ A link type may be declared on the need types that have it alone: its labels, styles, `copy` and dead links set by its first root by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2292
* 🏷️ builder.py: the overrides take Sphinx's parameter names; ten suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2294
* 📚 Per-type configuration or schema rules: docs, how-to and tested examples by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2295
* 🐛 Sort the needs_global_options unknown-keys finding by @shivampwm2020 in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290
* 📚 The documentation's own configuration uses per-type declarations by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2302
* 🏷️ Directive nodes declare their attributes' TypedDict; needextract's own four; fourteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2304
* 🐛 One rule for a link type's back links meeting a field or link type of their name by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2305
* 🧪 needs.json without its defaults, under per-type defaults: left out where a value equals its schema default as the same JSON type, restored from the file's own schema by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2306
* 📚 Need types: a walkthrough with diagrams, a reference without repeats, and the path of a need's values by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2309
* 🏷️ filter_common and needbar: nineteen suppressions gone, and two filter fast-path bugs fixed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2308
* 🐛 Need types and layouts added from code stay out of needs_types and needs_layouts, so an incremental build no longer reports a changed configuration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2307
* 🐛 Unset values in needtable sorts and layout placeholders, a changed needs_types on incremental builds, a needextend without needs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2311
* 🏷️ NeedsList declares the needs.json it holds; eleven suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2313
* 🏷️ needextend: an append's computed value is read as what it is; eight suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2315
* 🐛 needs_fields' default wins over needs_global_options', and needs.json writes a narrowed core field as declared by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2318

* ‼️ ub-needs-exchange 1.1.0: a format_version naming a later format refuses the file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2334
* ✨ target_types on a link type: which need types its links may point to by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2319
* 🐛 A network schema finding's header names the need the rule selected by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2340
* 🐛 target_types: refused on links beside a copying link type; how it combines with minItems by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2342
* ✨ A derived union of link types; `copy = true` deprecated into it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2343
* 📚 Derived fields get a page of their own by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2344
* 📚 Say X-as-Code on the docs landing page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2348
* Bump uv from 0.12.21 to 0.13.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2349
* Bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2351
* Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2352
* ⚡️ Filter strings in the portable filter language run without eval, five to six times faster, for the whole language; needs_debug_filters says which tier answered each filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2350
* 👌 Derive follow-ups: bare default-type entries, unions over late members, allow_dead_links beside an unreadable union by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2353
* 👌 A filter is read for its truth on every tier, and a filter that is a constant is refused by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2364
* 📚 Sphinx-Needs across the V-model: a page that maps define, implement, verify, iterate and prove by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2365
* ✨ Functions of your own can declare what they read, and every remaining late read is reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2366
* 📚 Changelog: what upgrading means for the new late-read warnings by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2367
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.1.0, with sphinx-codelinks 2.0.1 and sphinx-test-reports 3.0.1 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2368
* 🧪 The extension-field test skips without sphinx-test-reports, which the release compat cell never installs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2369

* @shivampwm2020 made their first contribution in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290

* 📚 sphinx-test-reports: a TestReports wordmark pair and favicon, like the sibling sites' by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2237
* 🔧 CI: Windows cells install a pinned graphviz zip, cached, instead of Chocolatey by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2238
* 📚 sphinx-codelinks: the front-page hero spans the content width by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2239
* 📚 sphinx-mounts, sphinx-test-reports: a front-page hero like sphinx-needs' and sphinx-codelinks' by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2240
* 🏷️ Ship py.typed in the four Sphinx extensions, and switch on the type rules already clean by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2241
* 🏷️ ruff ANN on shipped code: every function annotated by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2242
* 🐛 ty: possibly-unresolved-reference, disjoint-cast and missing-type-argument on, and the bug the first found by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2243
* 🏷️ #1835 cheap fixes: a latent TypeError in FieldSchema, and three suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2248
* 👌 sphinx-needs: warn once when a derived link type stores too many links by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2258
* 🐛 `:need:`, `:need_outgoing:`, `:need_incoming:` and needtable show a need with no document unlinked (#2244) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2261
* 🏷️ sphinx-codelinks: check_schema skips a field with no schema; five suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2267
* 🐛 measure_time: a callable with no __name__ or no source is measured; ty checks the wrapper by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2268
* ♻️ The fields schema answers per need type: `FieldsSchema.for_type` and `add_type_overlay` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2266
* 🏷️ list2need: a TypedDict for the parsed item; `_get_title` takes lines; fifteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2270
* 🏷️ ty's unsound-* rules on ub-project and scripts/: the last three findings fixed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2272
* ♻️ The fields schema has two tiers: the union answers a field's shape, `for_type` its declaration; frozen once read; a per-type declaration is a narrowing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2275
* ✨ `needs_types` as a table keyed by directive, beside the list, validated at config-inited; one need type registers its directive once by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2276
* ✨ A need type declares its fields: `inherits`, `fields` and `links` on a `needs_types` entry, resolved into the schema; a needextend `-field` empties by the need's type by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2278
* ✨ A need type can be `closed`: its needs hold only the fields it declares; a needextend refused on a type warns once; the fields schema is frozen once built; a per-type `minItems` on a link type or `tags` needs no default by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2281
* ✨ A field declared on need types alone: one name, one shape; `derive` inside a need type's entry; `closed` withdrawn before release by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2284
* 👌 A need refuses a write to a derived field; the resolver writes through its own setter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2289
* 🧪 Fields per need type: a conformance corpus both tools run, with its runner shared with the derive corpus; a derived value is checked against the field's own declaration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2291
* ✨ A link type may be declared on the need types that have it alone: its labels, styles, `copy` and dead links set by its first root by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2292
* 🏷️ builder.py: the overrides take Sphinx's parameter names; ten suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2294
* 📚 Per-type configuration or schema rules: docs, how-to and tested examples by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2295
* 🐛 Sort the needs_global_options unknown-keys finding by @shivampwm2020 in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290
* 📚 The documentation's own configuration uses per-type declarations by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2302
* 🏷️ Directive nodes declare their attributes' TypedDict; needextract's own four; fourteen suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2304
* 🐛 One rule for a link type's back links meeting a field or link type of their name by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2305
* 🧪 needs.json without its defaults, under per-type defaults: left out where a value equals its schema default as the same JSON type, restored from the file's own schema by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2306
* 📚 Need types: a walkthrough with diagrams, a reference without repeats, and the path of a need's values by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2309
* 🏷️ filter_common and needbar: nineteen suppressions gone, and two filter fast-path bugs fixed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2308
* 🐛 Need types and layouts added from code stay out of needs_types and needs_layouts, so an incremental build no longer reports a changed configuration by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2307
* 🐛 Unset values in needtable sorts and layout placeholders, a changed needs_types on incremental builds, a needextend without needs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2311
* 🏷️ NeedsList declares the needs.json it holds; eleven suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2313
* 🏷️ needextend: an append's computed value is read as what it is; eight suppressions gone by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2315
* 🐛 needs_fields' default wins over needs_global_options', and needs.json writes a narrowed core field as declared by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2318
* ‼️ Register the built-in GitHub services only when needs_services names them by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2321
* 🐛 A needs_links default wins over needs_global_options by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2328
* 🧪 Pin `required` on `content` in the schema fixtures by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2330
* ‼️ ub-needs-exchange 1.1.0: a format_version naming a later format refuses the file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2334
* ✨ target_types on a link type: which need types its links may point to by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2319
* 🐛 A network schema finding's header names the need the rule selected by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2340
* 🐛 target_types: refused on links beside a copying link type; how it combines with minItems by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2342
* ✨ A derived union of link types; `copy = true` deprecated into it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2343
* 📚 Derived fields get a page of their own by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2344
* 📚 Say X-as-Code on the docs landing page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2348
* Bump uv from 0.12.21 to 0.13.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2349
* Bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2351
* Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2352
* ⚡️ Filter strings in the portable filter language run without eval, five to six times faster, for the whole language; needs_debug_filters says which tier answered each filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2350
* 👌 Derive follow-ups: bare default-type entries, unions over late members, allow_dead_links beside an unreadable union by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2353
* 👌 A filter is read for its truth on every tier, and a filter that is a constant is refused by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2364
* 📚 Sphinx-Needs across the V-model: a page that maps define, implement, verify, iterate and prove by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2365
* ✨ Functions of your own can declare what they read, and every remaining late read is reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2366
* 📚 Changelog: what upgrading means for the new late-read warnings by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2367
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.1.0, with sphinx-codelinks 2.0.1 and sphinx-test-reports 3.0.1 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2368
* 🧪 The extension-field test skips without sphinx-test-reports, which the release compat cell never installs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2369

## New Contributors
* @shivampwm2020 made their first contribution in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2290

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/sphinx-codelinks-v2.0.0...sphinx-codelinks-v2.0.1

name: ub-test-reports v1.1.0
body:
Changelog:
<https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/blob/ub-test-reports-v1.1.0/packages/ub-test-reports/docs/changelog.rst>

## What's Changed
* 🔧 Update pre-commit hook versions by @useblocks-automation[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2010
* ⬆️ Update the uv lock (monthly) by @useblocks-automation[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2012
* 🐛 Normalize conf.py codelinks projects by @kocaemre in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2008
* 🧪 CI: upload coverage on pushes to master too by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2023
* ✨ sphinx-needs: `choose` / `when` / `otherwise` directives, one of several branches by variant data by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2020
* 🐛 fix: read JSON test reports as UTF-8 by @kocaemre in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2024
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: harden the `if` / `when` evaluator and `if` locations by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2029
* 🔧 Import sphinx-ai-index into the workspace, and build its index in every sphinx-* docs site by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2031
* 🔧 .gitignore: `ub-test-reports.xml`, the coverage file its CI step writes at the root by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2036
* 🧪 sphinx-ai-index: every text read and write in the tests names its encoding by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2037
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: register the URL string links at config-inited, not at read time by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2047
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: attach @need-ids references to the needs they name, during the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2049
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: incremental builds see new source files, and a project without a src-trace directive gets its @need-ids references by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2065
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: need-id order for `calc_sum` and `copy(filter=)` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2078
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a TOML `functions` key warns instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2079
* ✨ sphinx-needs: needextend `:extend_priority:`; warn where a filter depends on earlier extends by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2083
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a source file behind a symbolic link is analysed once by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2085
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: overlapping src-trace scopes no longer abort the build — the first directive defines a one-line need, the others skip it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2086
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: diagnose a git_root that does not contain src_dir, a file outside src_dir, and a :file: scope naming no file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2090
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: malformed one-line markers are reported in the build, at the source line by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2092
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a one-line need without an id field no longer crashes the directive when local URLs are on by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2093
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: the source copies and pages are build state — present in every HTML output, under -j N too by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2094
* 🔧 sphinx-codelinks: an .ignore at the root of every builder's output keeps it out of discovery by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2096
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needextend :+field: on an unset nullable field sets the field instead of crashing the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2102
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: under -j N, a need id defined in two workers renders its card once, on the document that kept it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2106
* 📚 Pull requests are written by people: the contributing policy on automatically generated PRs, a root CONTRIBUTING.md and a pull request template by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2110
* 🐛 the [needs.*], [mounts.*] and [codelinks.*] warning suffix appears once on Sphinx 7.4 with show_warning_types = True by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2108
* ✨ sphinx-needs: `needs.derive_unresolved` for reads of same-pass values by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2080
* 📚 sphinx-needs: document the processing order of needs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2081
* ✨ sphinx-needs: generate_need_id(), the public form of the id add_need derives for a need without one by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2111
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needs_functions shapes that crashed the build now warn by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2112
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a service that cannot be registered, or a needservice naming one that is not, warns instead of crashing the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2113
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a needextend option whose dynamic function cannot be parsed warns instead of aborting the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2116
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: tr_link no longer crashes on a need without the compared field by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2117
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: auto-expanded suites and cases keep their parent links when :links: contains the file id by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2118
* 🐛 ub-test-reports: link properties mapped onto one link field merge instead of overwriting by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2119

* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-env reads UTF-8 with a BOM, warns located and typed, spells scalars as JSON by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2161
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needimport imports a record without tags under :tags:, and reports a record whose content is not a string instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2163

* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields — derive on needs_fields and needs_links (configuration) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2178
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: the need directives warn instead of crashing; duplicate ids keep the first; extra options are case-blind by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2162
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: report text keeps every line inside its literal block by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2179
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a changed field or link configuration re-reads every document by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2192

* 🐛 sphinx-needs: the inline dynamic functions' parity fixes by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2194
* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields are computed — the kinds, links_from_filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2191

* 🧪 sphinx-ai-index: every text read and write in the tests names its encoding by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2037
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: register the URL string links at config-inited, not at read time by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2047
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: attach @need-ids references to the needs they name, during the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2049
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: incremental builds see new source files, and a project without a src-trace directive gets its @need-ids references by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2065
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: need-id order for `calc_sum` and `copy(filter=)` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2078
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a TOML `functions` key warns instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2079
* ✨ sphinx-needs: needextend `:extend_priority:`; warn where a filter depends on earlier extends by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2083
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a source file behind a symbolic link is analysed once by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2085
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: overlapping src-trace scopes no longer abort the build — the first directive defines a one-line need, the others skip it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2086
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: diagnose a git_root that does not contain src_dir, a file outside src_dir, and a :file: scope naming no file by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2090
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: malformed one-line markers are reported in the build, at the source line by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2092
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: a one-line need without an id field no longer crashes the directive when local URLs are on by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2093
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: the source copies and pages are build state — present in every HTML output, under -j N too by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2094
* 🔧 sphinx-codelinks: an .ignore at the root of every builder's output keeps it out of discovery by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2096
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needextend :+field: on an unset nullable field sets the field instead of crashing the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2102
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: under -j N, a need id defined in two workers renders its card once, on the document that kept it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2106
* 📚 Pull requests are written by people: the contributing policy on automatically generated PRs, a root CONTRIBUTING.md and a pull request template by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2110
* 🐛 the [needs.*], [mounts.*] and [codelinks.*] warning suffix appears once on Sphinx 7.4 with show_warning_types = True by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2108
* ✨ sphinx-needs: `needs.derive_unresolved` for reads of same-pass values by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2080
* 📚 sphinx-needs: document the processing order of needs by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2081
* ✨ sphinx-needs: generate_need_id(), the public form of the id add_need derives for a need without one by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2111
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needs_functions shapes that crashed the build now warn by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2112
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a service that cannot be registered, or a needservice naming one that is not, warns instead of crashing the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2113
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a needextend option whose dynamic function cannot be parsed warns instead of aborting the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2116
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: tr_link no longer crashes on a need without the compared field by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2117
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: auto-expanded suites and cases keep their parent links when :links: contains the file id by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2118
* 🐛 ub-test-reports: link properties mapped onto one link field merge instead of overwriting by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2119
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-report inserts its body as lines, records :file: as written, and no longer self-includes its template by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2125
* ‼️ sphinx-needs: needextend filters see the needs as written by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2127
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: report a marked-rst block on the row of its start marker by @patdhlk in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2021
* ‼️ sphinx-needs: dynamic functions and variants resolve in dependency order; cycles and out-of-scope reads warn by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2134
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: an empty need.FIELD selector fails the call, as an unset one does by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2136
* ✨ sphinx-needs: add_need parses a need's content in its declared markup, and ingest_need_record is one path for needs from outside the page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2135
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a read through computed links is a column read by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2143
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-results and test-env generate real sections by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2148
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: nested test suites at every depth, in the parser, the need directives and test-results by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2149
* 🧪 sphinx-codelinks: snapshot the real extraction output, with marker scope association (moved from sphinx-codelinks#100) by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2128
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: multi-line needs in source comments (@need … @endneed); the never-rendered @rst blocks are removed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2152
* ✨ sphinx-needs: needimport can parse imported content in the markup its doctype names by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2153
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: physical marker columns, need-ref spans, and Epydoc field tags in docstrings are not needs by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2129
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: an unreadable report is a typed, located warning and an error box by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2156
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: tree-sitter reads the whole source, so non-ASCII text no longer breaks its parse (lost YAML comments; lost bash, YAML and Go scopes) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2160
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-env reads UTF-8 with a BOM, warns located and typed, spells scalars as JSON by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2161
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needimport imports a record without tags under :tags:, and reports a record whose content is not a string instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2163
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: marked content on one row is listed in source order, so marked_content.json and the extraction snapshots are reproducible by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2164
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: src-trace renders multi-line needs — a block's body is parsed in its declared markup by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2168
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: TypeScript and JavaScript comment type (moved from sphinx-codelinks#82) by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2166
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: check_linked_values and a links_only calc_sum read a part link's need by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2177
* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields — derive on needs_fields and needs_links (configuration) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2178
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: the need directives warn instead of crashing; duplicate ids keep the first; extra options are case-blind by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2162
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: report text keeps every line inside its literal block by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2179
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a changed field or link configuration re-reads every document by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2192
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: exported link lists have a total order by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2193
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: the inline dynamic functions' parity fixes by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2194
* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields are computed — the kinds, links_from_filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2191
* 🧪 sphinx-needs: the derived-field conformance corpus by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2195
* ✨ sphinx-needs: the fingerprint derive kind — a digest of the whole need by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2204
* ✨ sphinx-needs: derive_by_type — a derive rule per need type by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2205
* 🐛 needimport and needs_external_needs read needs.json through one reader and one record path by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2189
* 🧪 CI: the Extensions cell runs its four large suites on four workers by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2210
* 📚 sphinx-needs: the Python floor raise gets its changelog bullet, and builders.rst describes the needs.json that is written by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2211
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.0.0 and the five members around it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2213
