name: sphinx-needs v9.0.0
body:
Changelog:
<https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html#release-9-0-0>

## What's Changed
* 🔧 Bump actions/checkout from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1834
* 🔧 Keep dependabot off the typing floor's stubs, and fence the floor against drift by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1837
* 🧪 Smoke-test the built package, out of the project by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1838
* 🔧 Restructure the repository into a uv workspace (packages/sphinx-needs) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1839
* 🔧 Label issues and pull requests by package: path-based for PRs, a form dropdown for issues by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1841
* ⬆️ Raise the Python floor to 3.11, and pin the workspace interpreter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1844
* 🧪 Replace Cypress with pytest-playwright for the JavaScript tests by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1845
* 🔧 One tag-driven release workflow for every workspace member, on trusted publishing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1846
* 🔧 Add a release planner and a fast import check, so the release order is known before the tag by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1848
* 🔧 Import sphinx-mounts into the workspace as packages/sphinx-mounts by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1850
* ⬆️ Bump the python-minor-and-patch group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1851
* 🔧 Skip the sphinx-mounts Read the Docs build on pull requests that do not touch it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1862
* 🧪 Let the sphinx-needs test suite be pointed at any PlantUML by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1863
* 🔧 One reusable test unit for every package's pytest cell by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1864
* 🔧 Skip the sphinx-needs Read the Docs build on pull requests that do not touch it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1866
* 📚 Say in the README why this is one repository but still several packages by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1867
* 🔧 One command for the mechanical half of a release pull request, and two release-pipeline follow-ups by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1869
* 🧪 Showcase variant sources and conditional mounts in the sphinx-mounts example by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1859
* 🔧 One pinned PlantUML for the whole workspace, vendored at vendor/plantuml/ by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1870
* 🔧 Import sphinx-codelinks into the workspace as packages/sphinx-codelinks by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1871
* ⬆️ Lift the typer cap in sphinx-codelinks, moving sphinxcontrib-typer past its own by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1896
* 🧪 Fence the PlantUML fence, and correct two sentences the dropped design left behind by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1897
* ⬆️ Bump ty from 0.0.77 to 0.0.78 in the ty group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1872
* 🧪 Run the sphinx-needs suite on four workers in CI, and print the slowest tests in every cell by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1899
* 🧪 Render PlantUML only where a test asks for it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1900
* 🔧 Read the Docs installs the workspace sibling from the checkout before the member by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1901
* 🧪 One way to assert on a build's warnings by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1902
* 📚 Document nested ports in needflow by @roli-lpci in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1868
* 📚 Fix typos and grammar errors in documentation by @ubmarco with @Copilot in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1630
* 🔧 One shared test layer for three suites: packages/sphinx-needs-testkit by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1904
* 🔧 Stop shipping the test suite in the sphinx-needs sdist by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1905
* 🧪 The parallel build test follows whichever story kept STORY_PAGE_1 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1908
* 🧪 Adopt the shared test layer in sphinx-mounts and sphinx-codelinks by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1907
* 🧪 fix: make sphinx-codelinks fixtures xdist-safe by @mikemikimike in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1912
* 👌 register common CSS files deterministically by @AlexanderLanin in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1914
* 🧪 sphinx-codelinks: one fixture for the worker-local dcdc copy by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1915
* 🧪 Subprocess builds run the interpreter under test by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1916
* 🧪 Every test in the sphinx-needs suite builds in process by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1917
* ‼️ Remove the 4.0 deprecation of `[[...]]` in need content, and the `need_func` role by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1919
* 📚 Make each example's sentence the need's own content in roles.rst by @Peter-Baer in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1201
* ♻️ Replace DataTables with an in-place, dependency-free needtable enhancer by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1920
* 🧪 Type-check needstable.js in CI by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1928
* 🔧 Import sphinx-test-reports into the workspace as packages/sphinx-test-reports by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1931
* 🔧 Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.0.1 to 10.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1933
* ⬆️ Bump ty from 0.0.78 to 0.0.80 in the ty group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1934
* ⬆️ Bump types-requests from 2.33.0.20260712 to 2.33.0.20260906 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1941
* 🔧 Stop dependabot rewriting manifest ranges it does not need to: versioning-strategy increase-if-necessary for the uv ecosystem by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1942
* 🔧 Dependabot: back to the default strategy, with the review rule written down by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1944
* ⬆️ Bump the python-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1940
* ⬆️ Bump the python-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1945
* 🔧 Dependabot: ignore docutils minor and major updates, the probe that fails every uv job by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1946
* ⬆️ Drop sphinx-codelinks' click cap: it pinned a package nothing uses by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1943

* ⬆️ Floor docutils at 0.21 across the workspace, and fence it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1977

* 🚀 Release ub-test-reports 1.0.0 by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2019

* 🐛 Normalize conf.py codelinks projects by @kocaemre in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2008

* ✨ sphinx-needs: `choose` / `when` / `otherwise` directives, one of several branches by variant data by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2020
* 🐛 fix: read JSON test reports as UTF-8 by @kocaemre in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2024

* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a service that cannot be registered, or a needservice naming one that is not, warns instead of crashing the build by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2113

* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: tr_link no longer crashes on a need without the compared field by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2117

* ✨ sphinx-needs: add_need parses a need's content in its declared markup, and ingest_need_record is one path for needs from outside the page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2135

* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-results and test-env generate real sections by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2148

* 🧪 sphinx-codelinks: snapshot the real extraction output, with marker scope association (moved from sphinx-codelinks#100) by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2128

* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: an unreadable report is a typed, located warning and an error box by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2156
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: tree-sitter reads the whole source, so non-ASCII text no longer breaks its parse (lost YAML comments; lost bash, YAML and Go scopes) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2160
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-env reads UTF-8 with a BOM, warns located and typed, spells scalars as JSON by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2161
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needimport imports a record without tags under :tags:, and reports a record whose content is not a string instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2163
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: marked content on one row is listed in source order, so marked_content.json and the extraction snapshots are reproducible by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2164
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: src-trace renders multi-line needs — a block's body is parsed in its declared markup by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2168

* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: the need directives warn instead of crashing; duplicate ids keep the first; extra options are case-blind by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2162
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: report text keeps every line inside its literal block by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2179
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a changed field or link configuration re-reads every document by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2192
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: exported link lists have a total order by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2193
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: the inline dynamic functions' parity fixes by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2194
* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields are computed — the kinds, links_from_filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2191
* 🧪 sphinx-needs: the derived-field conformance corpus by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2195

body:
Changelog:
<https://sphinx-mounts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html#release-0-3-0>

## What's Changed
* Fix failing test_styles tests. by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/47
* Allow Custom Options for Needs by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/48
* Issue 50 inconsistent logging import by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/51
* Add Hierarchy of Section Titles to Needs Metadata by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/53
* Adding support for optional and auto-generating titles per #49 by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/55
* Resolves issue #61 by ensuring dashes are replaced with underscores by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/62
* Fixes #63. Removing two hot spot performance issues related to adding sections and setting the link_backs. by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/64
* Prevent multiple link backs from being added. by @tlovett in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/65
* Bugfix: needimport fails to properly set hide attribute by @maglo in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/81
* link_types and export_id by @danwos in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/89
* Enable sorting on arbitrary numerical attributes by @aathn in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/92
* Add new config option to control title length in :need: references by @hkaimio in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/95
* Add parameter exclude parameter to meta_links_all by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/120
* Bugfix in meta_all for unwanted updates to INTERNALS global variable by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/121
* Added undocumented parameter no_links to meta_all() by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/122
* Added .venv and .envrc to gitignore by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/123
* Fix for role need_outgoing by @danwos in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/161
* fix copy-paste duplication in common.css by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/171
* fix typos by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/173
* fix boolean logic by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/180
* service mockup: add avatar handling by @danwos in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/189
* remove 'install_feather_icons' no-op by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/192
* fix logic bug by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/182
* A collection of tiny, pedantic, and unhelpful refactors by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/178
* remove python2 compatibility code by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/175
* remove python2 compatibility code and tidy imports in `tests` directory by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/174
* needtable default sort to id_complete by @danwos in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/190
* Docs for nested PlantUML elements. by @danwos in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/194
* Consolidate logging by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/167
* refactor environment.py by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/198

* remove duplicate plantuml legend creation logic by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/172

* tidy 'urlparse' imports by @danieleades in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/218

* ✨ sphinx-needs: add_need parses a need's content in its declared markup, and ingest_need_record is one path for needs from outside the page by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2135
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a read through computed links is a column read by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2143
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-results and test-env generate real sections by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2148
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: nested test suites at every depth, in the parser, the need directives and test-results by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2149
* 🧪 sphinx-codelinks: snapshot the real extraction output, with marker scope association (moved from sphinx-codelinks#100) by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2128
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: multi-line needs in source comments (@need … @endneed); the never-rendered @rst blocks are removed by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2152
* ✨ sphinx-needs: needimport can parse imported content in the markup its doctype names by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2153
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: physical marker columns, need-ref spans, and Epydoc field tags in docstrings are not needs by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2129
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: an unreadable report is a typed, located warning and an error box by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2156
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: tree-sitter reads the whole source, so non-ASCII text no longer breaks its parse (lost YAML comments; lost bash, YAML and Go scopes) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2160
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: test-env reads UTF-8 with a BOM, warns located and typed, spells scalars as JSON by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2161
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: needimport imports a record without tags under :tags:, and reports a record whose content is not a string instead of crashing by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2163
* 🐛 sphinx-codelinks: marked content on one row is listed in source order, so marked_content.json and the extraction snapshots are reproducible by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2164
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: src-trace renders multi-line needs — a block's body is parsed in its declared markup by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2168
* ✨ sphinx-codelinks: TypeScript and JavaScript comment type (moved from sphinx-codelinks#82) by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2166
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: check_linked_values and a links_only calc_sum read a part link's need by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2177
* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields — derive on needs_fields and needs_links (configuration) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2178
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports: the need directives warn instead of crashing; duplicate ids keep the first; extra options are case-blind by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2162
* 🐛 sphinx-test-reports, ub-test-reports: report text keeps every line inside its literal block by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2179
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: a changed field or link configuration re-reads every document by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2192
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: exported link lists have a total order by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2193
* 🐛 sphinx-needs: the inline dynamic functions' parity fixes by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2194
* ✨ sphinx-needs: declared derived fields are computed — the kinds, links_from_filter by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2191
* 🧪 sphinx-needs: the derived-field conformance corpus by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2195
* ✨ sphinx-needs: the fingerprint derive kind — a digest of the whole need by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2204
* ✨ sphinx-needs: derive_by_type — a derive rule per need type by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2205
* 🐛 needimport and needs_external_needs read needs.json through one reader and one record path by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2189
* 🧪 CI: the Extensions cell runs its four large suites on four workers by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2210
* 📚 sphinx-needs: the Python floor raise gets its changelog bullet, and builders.rst describes the needs.json that is written by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2211
* 🚀 Release: sphinx-needs 9.0.0 and the five members around it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/2213

name: ub-project v1.0.0
body:
Changelog:
<https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/blob/ub-project-v1.0.0/packages/ub-project/docs/changelog.rst>

The first release of `ub-project`, the shared reader for `ubproject.toml`; its whole history is the pull requests that added it, #1986 and #1987.

## What's Changed
* 📚 Label the three config sections intersphinx could not reach by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1793
* 🐛 needextract: six inputs that ended the build are now reported by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1795
* 🐛 needuml: report the inputs it used to ignore, and stop overwriting saved diagrams by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1800
* 🔧 Switch the lint runner from pre-commit to prek by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1804
* 🔧 Unify the ruff and mypy pins, and pin the rule set that goes with them by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1805
* 🔧 Add a scheduled `prek update` workflow by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1806
* 🔧 Track `uv.lock`, and pin CI's uv commands to it by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1807
* ✨ Accept the `cypher` option on `needpie` and `needbar` for ubCode compatibility by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1818
* ⬆️ Absorb the open dependabot PRs, and unblock their CI by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1819
* 📚 fix four typos in configuration.rst by @MsfPablo in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1801
* ⬆️ Bump pytest from 8.4.2 to 9.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1820
* ⬆️ Bump the python-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1822
* 🔧 Run the sphinx matrix from the lock, and retire tox for poe by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1823
* 🔧 Bump actions/setup-node from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1825

**8.3.1** is a small patch release with two bug fixes and a bundle of documentation and CI housekeeping.

### Bug fixes
- **PlantUML diagrams** now resolve `!include` paths from the physical source directory, so `needuml` / `needarch` / `needflow` render correctly for documents that live outside `srcdir` (for example via sphinx-mounts). ([#1750](https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1750))
- **PyPI release workflow** pins both `flit` and `flit_core` to the same version, fixing the release that failed when `flit` and `flit_core` versions drifted apart. ([#1756](https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1756))

### Documentation
- Replaced the bespoke `need-example` directive with the shared `syntax-example` directive from `sphinx-syntax-example`, matching the canonical implementation. ([#1746](https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1746))

### Housekeeping

- Stopped tracking the generated `tutorial_needs.json` in git. ([#1755](https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1755))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/8.3.0...8.3.1

## What's Changed

### ✨ `needs_role_need_template` is now rendered with Jinja

`needs_role_need_template` — and the inline `[[...]]` form of the `:need:` role — are now rendered with [Jinja](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/) instead of Python's `str.format` (#1738, closes #1697).

This brings Jinja's filters and control structures to need references — for example `{% if is_need %}…{% endif %}` or `{{ type | upper }}` — and adds the variables `id_complete`, `id_parent`, `id_part`, `is_need` and `is_part`, available directly or through a `need` object (e.g. `{{ need.type }}`).

**Backward compatible:** existing setups are unaffected on upgrade — a template still written in the old `str.format` style is detected and rendered the old way, emitting a single `needs.deprecated` warning that points at the migration (`{field}` → `{{ field }}`). The old syntax is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

Thanks to @PhilipPartsch for the initial proposal (#1698)!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/8.2.0...8.3.0

This release is all about **building one documentation source for many product variants**. If you maintain docs that differ by architecture, build flavour, feature flags or customer edition, the new variant-data tooling lets you describe those parameters once and let Sphinx-Needs do the branching — in filters, in need fields, in prose, and in whole sections. The other headline is `network_back` schema validation, which finally lets you express link-coverage rules from the side of the relationship where they actually make sense.

**Full Changelog:** [`v8.1.1...v8.2.0`](https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/8.1.1...8.2.0)

## ✨ Variant data: describe your build once, reuse it everywhere

The centrepiece of 8.2.0 is [`needs_variant_data`](https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration.html#needs-variant-data) — a structured, namespaced replacement for the old flat `needs_filter_data`. You define your variant parameters as ordinary (nestable) data and read them back through a clean `var` namespace:

```python
# conf.py
needs_variant_data = {
    "cpu": "arm",
    "debug": True,
    "build": {"optimization": 2, "features": ["feature_a", "feature_b"]},
}
```

Once configured, the same `var` data is available in four complementary ways, so you can pick the right tool for each spot in your docs:

- **In filters** — `var.build.debug` reads far more naturally than the old bracket syntax, and nested data avoids clashing with your need field names:

  ```rst
  .. needtable::
     :filter: var.cpu == "arm" and var.build.debug == True
  ```

- **In need field values** — inject a variant value straight into a field with the new [`<{ ... }>` syntax](https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/dynamic_functions.html#needs-variant-data-references) (for any field flagged `parse_variants`):

  ```rst
  .. req:: Example
     :id: VD_001
     :arch: <{ var.cpu }>
  ```

- **In prose** — the new [`variant` role](https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/roles.html#variant) drops a resolved value straight into your text, rendering the configured `cpu` value as `arm`.

- **In whole blocks** — the new [`if` directive](https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/directives/if.html) includes or excludes entire sections (needs and all) at parse time, based on a `var` expression:

  ```rst
  .. if:: var.cpu == "arm"

     This section — and every need inside it — is only built for ARM.
  ```

Variant data can also be loaded from JSON via [`needs_variant_data_file`](https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration.html#needs-variant-data-file) and swapped per build with `sphinx-build -D needs_variant_data_file=...`, making it easy to generate variant-specific outputs from a single source tree (#1715, #1716, #1721, #1737).

## Improvements

- ✨ Add a `network_back` schema-validation key, the sibling of `network`, that validates a need's **incoming** links instead of its outgoing ones. This lets you state a rule from the target's point of view — for example *"every requirement must be covered by at least one test"* — once, on the requirement, instead of repeating it on every test. It reuses the familiar `items` / `contains` / `minContains` / `maxContains` structure and can be freely mixed and nested with `network` (see [Incoming link validation](https://sphinx-needs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/schema/index.html#incoming-link-validation-network-back)) (#1731)
- 👌 Allow link fields in `needservice` directive options, so needs created via a custom service can declare links to other needs (#1632). Thanks to @filipepcampos
- 👌 Honor `-D` command-line overrides when loading needs from a TOML file, so per-build configuration works as expected (#1717)
- 👌 Include the JSON location (path) in `$ref` resolution error messages, making schema-configuration mistakes much easier to track down (#1736)
- 👌 Track JSON files imported via `needimport` as build dependencies, so editing an imported file triggers a rebuild (#1730). Thanks to @yhontyk
- 🔧 Add a root `context7.json` configuration file so AI assistants using Context7 can discover the live Sphinx-Needs documentation and use the project-specific reference instead of stale training data (#1719)

## Deprecations

- ⚠️ Deprecate `needs_filter_data` in favour of the new, structured `needs_variant_data`. It keeps working for now but emits a warning; the flat data it provides is injected at the filter root and can collide with need field names, which the namespaced `var` data avoids (#1715)

## Breaking changes

- ‼️ Remove the discontinued **Open-Needs** service (#1732)

  The Open-Needs project is discontinued and `open-needs.org` no longer resolves, so the `open-needs` service has been removed. The `sphinx_needs.services.open_needs.OpenNeedsService` import and the `params`, `prefix` and `url_postfix` extra fields that the service registered are no longer available.

## Bug fixes

- 🐛 Fix `needpie` raising `All wedge sizes are zero` on matplotlib 3.11+ when a pie has no data (e.g. zero matching needs); an empty pie with its legend is now rendered instead (#1727)
- 🐛 Sort need link and backlink lists in `needs.json` and HTML output using natural, case-insensitive ordering (e.g. `REQ_2` < `REQ_9` < `REQ_10`) and collapse duplicate entries, so build outputs are reproducible regardless of need load order (e.g. when using `needs_external_needs`) (#1371)
- 🐛 Fix parent-child relationship of newly created nodes for needs. This fixes interoperability with Sphinx extensions that look up source lines, like sphinxcontrib-spelling (#1564). Thanks to @tim-nordell-nimbelink

## What's Changed

* ⚡️ Add `NeedItem.is_in_document()` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1709
* 🐛 Fix `needs_schema_definitions` triggering full rebuilds by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1712
* 🚀 Release v8.1.1 by @ubmarco in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1713


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/8.1.0...8.1.1

This release focuses on **filter performance improvements** and bug fixes.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/compare/8.0.0...8.1.0

### Performance

- ⚡️ Short-circuit simple filter expressions to avoid `eval()` overhead (#1677)

  Common filter patterns (e.g. `id == "REQ_001"`, `type == "spec"`) are now matched and evaluated directly without invoking Python's `eval()`, significantly reducing filtering time for large need sets.

- ⚡️ Add `NeedItem.filter_context()` to avoid costly `{**need}` unpacking (#1706)

  Filter evaluation no longer creates a full dictionary copy of each need on every filter call, reducing memory allocations and improving throughput.

- ⚡️ Cache `NeedLink` filter string (#1705)

  Pre-compute and store the filter string on `NeedLink` construction, avoiding repeated string formatting on every access through `NeedItem.__getitem__`.

### Bug fixes

- 🐛 Fix `needflow` rendering very dark / black nodes when a need type has no `color` set in `needs_types` (#1664, #1702).
  Previously a hard-coded `#000000` fallback was used as the fill color, which produced unreadable nodes — especially under browser dark mode. When no color is configured, no color is emitted and the diagram engine's default node color is used.

  > **Note:** This is a minor behavior change for users with `needs_types` entries that omit the `color` key: diagrams (`needflow`, `needuml`, `needgantt`) that previously rendered such nodes as solid black will now render them with the diagram engine's default node color (typically light). To preserve the old appearance, set `"color": "#000000"` explicitly on the affected `needs_types` entry.

- 🐛 Fix `:need:` role in section headings by registering `NeedRef` node with Sphinx's LaTeX builder (#1700).

* 👌 Improve logging for static file copies by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/992
* 🔧 Centralise access to sphinx-needs config by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/998
* 🔧 Centralise sphinx `env` data access (and add schemas) by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/987
* 🔧 Add strict typing for `sphinx_needs.builder` by @chrisjsewell in https://github.com/useblocks/sphinx-needs/pull/1000
